en.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

zhSimplified.text: 提幔人以利法回答说：

zhTraditional.text: 提幔人以利法回答說：

en.text: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

zhSimplified.text: 人若想与你说话，你就厌烦吗？ 但谁能忍住不说呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人若想與你說話，你就厭煩嗎？ 但誰能忍住不說呢？

en.text: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

zhSimplified.text: 你素来教导许多的人， 又坚固软弱的手。

zhTraditional.text: 你素來教導許多的人， 又堅固軟弱的手。

en.text: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

zhSimplified.text: 你的言语曾扶助那将要跌倒的人； 你又使软弱的膝稳固。

zhTraditional.text: 你的言語曾扶助那將要跌倒的人； 你又使軟弱的膝穩固。

en.text: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

zhSimplified.text: 但现在祸患临到你，你就昏迷， 挨近你，你便惊惶。

zhTraditional.text: 但現在禍患臨到你，你就昏迷， 挨近你，你便驚惶。

en.text: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

zhSimplified.text: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏 神吗？ 你的盼望不是在你行事纯正吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你的倚靠不是在你敬畏上帝嗎？ 你的盼望不是在你行事純正嗎？

en.text: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

zhSimplified.text: 请你追想：无辜的人有谁灭亡？ 正直的人在何处剪除？

zhTraditional.text: 請你追想：無辜的人有誰滅亡？ 正直的人在何處剪除？

en.text: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

zhSimplified.text: 按我所见，耕罪孽、种毒害的人 都照样收割。

zhTraditional.text: 按我所見，耕罪孽、種毒害的人 都照樣收割。

en.text: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

zhSimplified.text: 神一出气，他们就灭亡； 神一发怒，他们就消没。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝一出氣，他們就滅亡； 上帝一發怒，他們就消沒。

en.text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

zhSimplified.text: 狮子的吼叫和猛狮的声音尽都止息； 少壮狮子的牙齿也都敲掉。

zhTraditional.text: 獅子的吼叫和猛獅的聲音盡都止息； 少壯獅子的牙齒也都敲掉。

en.text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

zhSimplified.text: 老狮子因绝食而死； 母狮之子也都离散。

zhTraditional.text: 老獅子因絕食而死； 母獅之子也都離散。

en.text: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

zhSimplified.text: 我暗暗地得了默示； 我耳朵也听其细微的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 我暗暗地得了默示； 我耳朵也聽其細微的聲音。

en.text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

zhSimplified.text: 在思念夜中、异象之间， 世人沉睡的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 在思念夜中、異象之間， 世人沉睡的時候，

en.text: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

zhSimplified.text: 恐惧、战兢临到我身， 使我百骨打战。

zhTraditional.text: 恐懼、戰兢臨到我身， 使我百骨打戰。

en.text: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

zhSimplified.text: 有灵从我面前经过， 我身上的毫毛直立。

zhTraditional.text: 有靈從我面前經過， 我身上的毫毛直立。

en.text: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 那灵停住， 我却不能辨其形状； 有影像在我眼前。 我在静默中听见有声音说：

zhTraditional.text: 那靈停住， 我卻不能辨其形狀； 有影像在我眼前。 我在靜默中聽見有聲音說：

en.text: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

zhSimplified.text: 必死的人岂能比 神公义吗？ 人岂能比造他的主洁净吗？

zhTraditional.text: 必死的人豈能比上帝公義嗎？ 人豈能比造他的主潔淨嗎？

en.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

zhSimplified.text: 主不信靠他的臣仆， 并且指他的使者为愚昧；

zhTraditional.text: 主不信靠他的臣僕， 並且指他的使者為愚昧；

en.text: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

zhSimplified.text: 何况那住在土房、根基在尘土里、 被蠹虫所毁坏的人呢？

zhTraditional.text: 何況那住在土房、根基在塵土裏、 被蠹蟲所毀壞的人呢？

en.text: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

zhSimplified.text: 早晚之间，就被毁灭， 永归无有，无人理会。

zhTraditional.text: 早晚之間，就被毀滅， 永歸無有，無人理會。

en.text: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

zhSimplified.text: 他帐棚的绳索岂不从中抽出来呢？ 他死，且是无智慧而死。

zhTraditional.text: 他帳棚的繩索豈不從中抽出來呢？ 他死，且是無智慧而死。
